summary_paragraph: Mr. Johnson, a patient with stage IV cholangiocarcinoma and biliary stents, was admitted with fever, chills, and elevated bilirubin. Imaging showed stent obstruction with sludge and pus, leading to cholangitis. He underwent an ERCP where both stents were cleared, and a new plastic stent was placed. His liver function improved, fevers resolved, and he was switched to oral antibiotics. Chemotherapy was held during admission and rescheduled. He was discharged home in stable condition with plans for stent removal in six weeks and resumed oncology care.
